verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API with Bearer/OAuth auth that lets developers create and manipulate content programmatically, which covers the 'local endpoint' part of the story, but there is no evidence of a URI scheme or deep-link mechanism for opening/creating notes from outside the app, and no independent confirmation of the API in real workflows. missing for 10: URI scheme/deep-link support, independent hands-on verification of API-driven note creation, explicit 'open note' endpoint documentation.
